messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need help urgently. I just got an alert that my credit score dropped 127 points overnight! Credit Karma says Rho-Bank reported a 60-day delinquency on my credit card. But I’ve NEVER missed a payment — I have autopay! I checked my Rho-Bank account and all my payments are current. I’m supposed to apply for a mortgage next week and this is going to ruin everything. What is going on?!
